narr: A mesolow formed over southeastern Virginia on September 18. This feature, along with tropical moisture from the remnants of Potential Tropical Cyclone Eight, allowed for nearly stationary storms which produced very heavy and efficient rainfall. Several instances of flash flooding were reported across a relatively localized portion of southeast Virginia.
ev: The Sussex County Police Department reported flooding along Courthouse Road.
Flooding was reported by the Sussex County Police Department on Virginia 35 near Cabin Point Road. An NWS employee confirmed water flowing over the road.
VDOT reported that Rocky Hock Road was closed due to flooding near the Surry County and Sussex County border.
VDOT reported that White Marsh Road was closed due to flooding near Southampton Road.

An NWS employee reported culverts overwhelmed by the heavy rain with a small portion of a gravel driveway partially washed out by the water flowing across it. The water also rose to and was surrounding an electrical box. Standing water was noted in several neighborhood yards along Log Road.
